svg.title: Claymark wordmark (light surfaces)
svg.desc: Text-based, not outlined to paths — reproducing it faithfully elsewhere needs the actual Inter font available (the same 600-weight file this app already bundles at public/fonts/, or src/main/assets in the native build), same as any text-based wordmark SVG. Color is the exact light-theme --text-primary token value (Neutral.n1000, hsl(60,3.4%,15%) → #282825), computed from the real HSL formula rather than approximated — not the "#2a2420" placeholder this document used before the icon's own hex-lock discipline was applied here too.
